note: Main-package ids of every vetted release, by version. CI rebuilds the version in daml.yaml from a clean checkout and asserts the id matches the entry here. That assertion IS the reproducibility claim: a build that cannot be reproduced byte-for-byte cannot be checked against what the network vetted.
packageNameReferenceNote: How a CLIENT should name our templates when it SUBMITS: '#arccade-game-sdk:ArCCade.GameSdk.Cycle:GameStake'. Canton resolves a package-name reference to the highest vetted version, so it cannot go stale on upgrade, and it is what docs/INTEGRATION.md 2.3 and 7 tell integrators to pass as sdkPackageId. It is NOT what a client READS: the ledger always emits a package-id-qualified templateId in a transaction stream, so reader fixtures must carry a real id from `ids` instead.

external.note: Package ids that are not ours. They are recorded here so that a conformance fixture can name one without a bare literal appearing in generate.mjs, and so that the manifest check has a closed set to test membership against: every package id in package-id position in conformance/manifest.json must be either `packageNameReference` or an id listed in this file. Nothing here is OURS to keep stable — see `stability` on each entry.

packages.role: Splice.AmuletRules:AmuletRules, Splice.Amulet:Amulet and Splice.Amulet:LockedAmulet — the custody half of write 1 and write 2.
packages.resolvedBy: the templateId prefix of the AmuletRules contract served by Canton Scan. arccade-wallet-sdk-proxy/src/gameCustody.js fetchAmuletRules() reads it that way at runtime and caches it for 60s; it is deliberately not in that service's config, because config would make it a second source of truth against the disclosure blob it must agree with.
packages.whyNotPinnedByClients: The DSO votes in new splice-amulet releases and the id changes with every one: 0.1.15, 0.1.16, 0.1.17, 0.1.18, 0.1.19, 0.1.20, 0.1.21 and 0.1.22 are ALL vetted on this participant right now, and the live AmuletRules is on 0.1.22. A client that pins this id keeps working until the next DSO vote and then stops. docs/DESIGN.md 550 records the same fact. The value here is therefore a WITNESS of what was live when the fixture was cut, not a constant: the builder cases treat amuletPackageId as a caller-supplied parameter and assert only that the builder places it in the templateId prefix unmodified.
